summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with inline coordinate computation; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; reworked GridPatchDataset with patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; np.ceil replaces math; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_length). Not verified: no tests were run, and the pinned random values in test_loading_array are unconfirmed. Line lengths were checked by grep; only pre-existing lines in get_valid_patch_size exceed 120 columns.
